$comment: Single source of truth for GitHub release asset filenames and their signing status. Consumed by scripts/docs/check-site-claims.ts (download-link + 'signed' claim verification) and the desktop build scripts. Update filenames HERE first. `signed` reflects whether the shipped artifact is actually code-signed/notarized today. Electrobun 2 drops the channel prefix from STABLE INSTALLER names (verified against a real build: `win-x64-JxStudio-Setup.zip`) while the updater feed keeps it (`stable-win-x64-update.json`) — so these download links carry no `stable-`, and existing 1.18 installs still find the same update feed. macOS x64 is absent because Electrobun 2 publishes no macos-x64 core archive.
